toegepas.voor: voor die klok aan die einde lui
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'aan die einde lui' is vague and wooden; 'die laaste klok' is the natural Afrikaans phrase and is shorter.
toegepas.fout: 'aan die einde' leaves unsaid the end of what, and reads wooden
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'die laaste klok' is the natural phrase for the end-of-day bell and keeps the meaning.

toegepas.voor: Iemand moet kos maak en iemand
toegepas.na: Iemand moet kos maak, en iemand
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both halves have their own subject (iemand) and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma.

toegepas.voor: Dalk haal jy water of pas jy
toegepas.na: Dalk haal jy water, of pas jy
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: 'of' joins two clauses that each have their own subject (jy) and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'haal jy' and 'pas jy' each state subject and verb, so the comma before 'of' is required.

toegepas.voor: aan die gang en dit is samewerking
toegepas.na: aan die gang, en dit is samewerking
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Julle hou' and 'dit is' are two full clauses, so the comma before 'en' is required.

toegepas.blok: Wat 'n groep vir jou kan doen
toegepas.voor: Een teken mooi en een ken
toegepas.na: Een teken mooi, en 'n ander ken
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Een ... en een' is ambiguous (could be the same child); 'n ander' makes clear it is a second child, and AWS needs the comma between two clauses.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two clauses, and 'een ... en een' can read as the same child
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required, and 'n ander' makes it clear that there are two children, which is what the text means.

toegepas.blok: Wat 'n groep vir jou kan doen
toegepas.voor: waar dit nog nie klaar gedink is nie
toegepas.na: waar jy nog nie klaar gedink het nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: The passive 'dit is nie klaar gedink nie' is unidiomatic; a person finishes thinking, not an idea.
toegepas.fout: the passive 'dit is nog nie klaar gedink nie' is unidiomatic
toegepas.rede_keurder: The active form says the same thing (your idea is not yet thought through) in natural Afrikaans.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Groepwerk loop' and 'jy ken' are two full clauses, so the comma is required.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'sit terug' is a calque of English 'sit back'; Afrikaans says 'sit net'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'sit net' is the natural Afrikaans for a child who sits doing nothing, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'al die werk' is the natural Afrikaans phrase; 'die hele werk' sounds translated.
toegepas.fout: 'die hele werk' reads translated after 'laat ... doen'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'al die werk' is the natural fixed phrase here, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Niemand wil die vloer vee wat nog gedoen moet word nie.
toegepas.na: Niemand wil die vloer vee nie, maar dit moet nog gedoen word.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The relative clause 'wat nog gedoen moet word' attaches to 'die vloer', so the sentence says the floor must be done; splitting it fixes the reference.
toegepas.fout: the relative clause attaches to 'die vloer', so the sentence makes the reader stumble
toegepas.rede_keurder: Splitting it into two clauses with an AWS comma before 'maar' says the same thing clearly.

toegepas.voor: Iemand sê sy idee sag en die groep werk sommer daaroor verby
toegepas.na: Iemand sê sy idee sag, en die groep gaan sommer daarby verby
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'daaroor verby werk' is not Afrikaans; 'by iets verbygaan' is the idiom for ignoring something, and AWS needs the comma between two clauses.
toegepas.fout: 'daaroor verby werk' is not an Afrikaans expression, and the AWS comma is missing
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'by iets verbygaan' is the idiom for ignoring something, which is what the sentence means, and the comma is required.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb
toegepas.rede_keurder: ''n ander kind sê' and 'almal luister' are two full clauses, so the comma is required.

toegepas.voor: Dit voel onregverdig en dit bly lank
toegepas.na: Dit voel onregverdig en bly lank
toegepas.rede_vinder: The repeated 'dit' is unnecessary; with one subject the sentence is shorter and needs no comma.
toegepas.fout: two clauses joined without the required AWS comma, with a needless repeated subject
toegepas.rede_keurder: With one subject the sentence is shorter, needs no comma, and means the same.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans needs the closing 'nie' after 'niks' in the relative clause.
toegepas.fout: the negation 'niks' in the relative clause lacks its closing 'nie'
toegepas.rede_keurder: Afrikaans grammar requires 'wat niks doen nie' in the middle of a sentence.

toegepas.voor: wat alles besluit wat jy self dink
toegepas.na: wat alles besluit, wat jy self dink
toegepas.rede_vinder: Two 'wat' clauses run together; a comma after the relative clause shows where it ends.
toegepas.fout: two 'wat' clauses run together, so 'besluit wat jy self dink' can be misread
toegepas.rede_keurder: A comma at the end of the relative clause shows where it stops, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'vasbly' means to hold on; 'vassit' is the verb for being stuck.
toegepas.fout: 'Bly die groep vas' can read as the idiom 'vasbly' (to hang on) instead of being stuck
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Sit die groep nog vas' clearly means still stuck, keeps the sense of continuing, and leaves who to ask unchanged.

toegepas.rede_keurder: This is a plain punctuation fix that changes no wording in the definition, so it is allowed under the glossary rule.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat 'n groep vir jou kan doen
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'sommer' is colloquial and vague for Grade 4; 'maklik' states the contrast with 'te swaar' clearly.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'sommer' is natural Afrikaans a Grade 4 reader knows, so swapping it for 'maklik' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat 'n groep vir jou kan doen
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: In written standard Afrikaans an object such as a box is referred to with 'dit', not the spoken 'hom'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'hom' for a box is normal written Afrikaans, so this is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: toe en hy vee die vloer
laat_vaar.na: toe, en hy vee die vloer
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: AWS: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subjects (jy, hy) and verbs.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Both clauses are part of what the command 'Sê' tells you to say, and a comma would split the second clause off from that command.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'iets staan tussen julle' is the idiomatic way to say a quarrel comes between people; 'bly tussen julle' reads unfinished.
na_skrywer.fout: 'bly tussen julle' can be read as the idiom for keeping something secret
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but 'staan tussen julle' shifts the sense from a quarrel that lingers to one that divides, so the writer should choose the fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'werk met 'n naam' is opaque for a Grade 4 reader; 'n eie stukkie werk' says it is a task that is clearly his, and is shorter.
na_skrywer.fout: 'werk met 'n naam' is unclear to a Grade 4 reader
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but 'n eie stukkie werk' changes 'a specific, named task' into 'his own task', so the writer should choose the fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: Woorde soos ek dink so werk
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A quoted phrase needs quotation marks, and 'ek dink so' means 'I agree' in Afrikaans, not stating your own view.
na_skrywer.fout: the quoted phrase has no quotation marks, so the sentence makes the reader stumble
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The quotation marks are needed, but dropping 'so' changes the example phrase itself, which is the writer's content decision.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Gee die kind wat niks doen 'n stukkie werk met 'n naam.
vlae.rede: If 'met 'n naam' was meant literally (a task given a name, so the child knows exactly which part is his), the proposed 'n eie stukkie werk' keeps the sense but loses that detail; the reviewer should check.

vlae.teks: Bly die groep vas, vra die juffrou of 'n grootmens by die huis.
vlae.rede: This is the lesson's help-seeking line; the proposed change touches only the verb and keeps who to ask. Any further change must not drop the adult.
